title: Chapter 802
text:
You have joined a new faction — [Black Star Corps]!

You have received an identity — [Black Star Corps Member]!

[Black Star Corps] Faction Interface Unlocked.

[Black Star Corps] Merit System Unlocked.

[Black Star Corps] Faction Store Unlocked.

In the crowded Planet Gilman army branch hall, Vodka and his guild officers walked out of the combat test room with the crowd. They were all looking at the notification on the interface with joy.

Looking at the unlocked faction store, the dazzling array of products made them unable to move their eyes away.

"Vice President, there's news from the club. They're asking about the situation."

"Haha, tell them there's no problem. We can let those pro players join. As expected of a growing faction that has been run by the Shattered Star Ring players for two to three versions. There's almost all the class knowledge from basic to advanced." Vodka rubbed his hands and was still in a state of excitement.

At this time, a group of guild players walked toward them. The leader was the vice president of the Kangaroo Guild, 'Captain Old Henry'. It was the official guild under the famous Australian professional club, 'Kangaroo Boxing'. It was also Vodka's old enemy, and the two sides had fought many guild wars.

"Hey guys, you guys are here earlier than us." Captain Old Henry saw Vodka and the others and raised his hand to greet them.

"You guys are here too?" Vodka stopped and started chatting with them.

No discord, no concord. After playing together for three versions, they were familiar with each other and could be considered half friends. When they weren't in guild wars, their relationship was pretty good. Although they were competitors, there wasn't a deep hatred between the players.

"You guys have already joined?"

"Yeah, there are quite a lot of people. Take your time to line up."

After chatting for a while, Captain Old Henry brought his people to take the test. Vodka's Old Henry watched them leave and touched his lips.

One of the guild officers whispered, "Every guild will send people to join the army. No one will let go of this opportunity. In that case, everyone will be on the same side in the future, and there will be less competition."

"Humph, you're wrong. Since the Black Star Corps is going to expand, there will definitely be a large number of quest resources appearing in the short term. Even if there are a lot of resources, there will still be differences between the good and the bad. For better quests and better resource points, the various large guilds will definitely fight for them. I don't think the competition between the guilds will decrease. Instead, it will become more frequent." Vodka shook his head.

"Is that so? From what I see, the Chinese people in the Shattered Star Ring rarely participate in guild wars to snatch resources."

"Who said so? They're the same, just not as intense. After all, most of them are Chinese guilds, so they don't fight much. On the other hand, we have too many guilds from different countries, so we're natural opponents. Moreover, our factions have been opposing each other for so long, so everyone is used to it."

As he spoke, Vodka suddenly remembered something and his spirit was lifted.

"By the way, speaking of the Shattered Star Ring … we're now members of the Black Star Corps. The army is a cross-Star Field faction, and the main camp is over there. I wonder if we can follow the army to the Shattered Star Ring."

This was a crucial question, and everyone was curious.

Vodka took out his communicator and downloaded the Army Assistant according to the instructions.

Hum! Philip's virtual projection appeared on the screen. It was about the size of a finger and looked extremely cute. It bowed obediently and said, "Welcome to the Black Star Corps.

"Welcome to the Black Star Army's internal assistant, hum … I'm a subprogram of the army artificial intelligence, Philip. I'm very happy to serve the brave Black Star warriors. If you're willing, you can give me a new appearance and a new name, hum …"

"Oh, cute …"

The cute projection hit his weak spot, and the vodka heart was about to melt. He was originally a strong bearded man, but now he was smiling like a wrinkled chrysanthemum that had grown hair. He didn't look like a Russian bear-fighter at all.

"Cough, Vice President, mind your image." The guild officer by the side almost wanted to dig his eyes out.

Vodka wiped his mouth and hurriedly asked, "I would like to ask, can we, the new members, follow the army back to the Shattered Star Ring?"

"It's like this. Following the highest order of the Army Commander, the people recruited here will usually stay behind to help the army expand. However, if you want to go to the army's main camp, hum. According to the army's itinerary, we will borrow the stargate channel of the Red Empire from time to time to transport resources from the main camp to the Constellation Corridor branch. If you really want to go to the Shattered Star Ring, you can submit an application and follow the transport team back, hum. "

Everyone was shocked. They looked at each other with excitement in their eyes. Indeed, they could really cross Star Fields.

Vodka suppressed his excitement and asked, "Then, will the army be returning to the Shattered Star Ring soon?"

"Yes, hum." Philip counted with his fingers and said in a crisp voice, "The Legion Commander will be here for a period of time before he departs. It will probably take a month or two. When the time comes, you can follow the Legion Commander back, hum."

Vodka's eyes sparkled. He nodded and looked back at everyone.

"We need to talk to the president and the club …"

…

The first batch of players who happened to stay on Planet Gilman joined the army one after another and shared all kinds of news about the army on the forums.

The players of the various Star Fields were all paying attention to the Constellation Corridor forum. Most of them knew that the Constellation Corridor players could choose to cross Star Fields and were very envious.

Those Constellation Corridor players who were still on their way to Planet Gilman could not help but discuss this topic on the forums, debating whether to stay or leave.

A large portion of them hesitated.

"We've played in the Constellation Corridor for a few versions and are very familiar with this place. If we go to the Shattered Star Ring now, won't all our efforts be wasted? Staying here will still be doing the army's mission. There's no need to go to the Shattered Star Ring and start all over again. "

"That's right. The main reason we joined the army is for their benefits. Why go to the Shattered Star Ring? There are millions of players there, and most of them are Chinese. They've been operating there for a few versions, and we have no advantage over them. We still have to compete with them over there. "

"That's right. We haven't even finished exploring the Constellation Corridor. Why go to another Star Field?"

"This is the Central Galaxy, the most prosperous place in the universe. If we don't develop here and go to a remote Star Field, won't we be wasting our time?"

The time and effort invested in the three versions were sunk costs. Many players were reluctant to give up the fruits of their labor.

If they could go and return at any time, they would not hesitate. However, they could only follow the army to cross Star Fields. Who knew how often the army would send out a transport team? Furthermore, they did not know if they would be allowed to return. If they were not satisfied in the Shattered Star Ring, who knew how long it would take for them to return?

Of course, there were always opposing voices, but there were also players who agreed to go to the Shattered Star Ring.

"We're the first batch of players to cross Star Fields. Why should we give up such a good opportunity? The others don't even have a way to cross Star Fields."

"Go and play with our Chinese comrades in the Shattered Star Ring."

"Don't forget that the Flickering World mission is at the top of the army's mission list. It's obviously a new main storyline. Furthermore, the mission introduction states that the development of the Flickering World is the Red Empire's operation, and the Black Star Corps is only one of the participants. This main storyline is more like the dynasty's own storyline! Therefore, by joining the army to explore the Flickering World, we're actually working for the Red Empire! "

"That's right. Maybe helping the dynasty explore a new Star Field is one of the main storylines of the Constellation Corridor. The Black Star Corps might be recruiting us to bring us over and let us participate in the mission."

In the past ten years, the Red Empire's plans for the Flickering World were known to everyone. The players in the territory of the Red Empire naturally knew about it. Although they did not know the importance of the Flickering World in the future, they were very interested in it.

After the Tyrant's Party, Han Xiao had kept the Flickering World main storyline mission at the top of the army's list. After such a long time, the effect was obvious. It was just right to attract the Constellation Corridor players to explore the Flickering World with him. It was also convenient for him to transplant the wild leeks into the greenhouse at home.

Of course, it was impossible for him to recruit all the players in the Constellation Corridor at once. Meeting the Ruler would only take a few days, but Han Technician had planned to stay in the Constellation Corridor for two to three months before he left. His goal was to give the players there enough time to make up their minds. From his standpoint, the more players who were willing to explore the Flickering World with him, the better.

…

The debate on the forums was getting more and more intense. A few days later, more and more players rushed to Planet Gilman to join the army, and more and more people gathered.

Very soon, the number of players on Planet Gilman exceeded two million, and the number was increasing every day.

Almost all the large guilds had a base on Planet Gilman. Very soon, the club guilds in Russia, Australia, and various small countries began to discuss this issue.

In the base of the Power and Glory guild, the presidents and vice presidents of the six large Russian guilds gathered. These six guilds were the largest guilds in Russia, and they all had club backgrounds behind them. They were basically the representatives of the Russian professional circle and were the leaders in the hearts of many Russian players. They would occasionally fight guild wars with each other, but they would also discuss countermeasures together when something big happened.

"Everyone, has your club made up your mind? Have you decided to stay or leave?" the president of the Power and Glory guild asked.

"The people above said that the team members will not be going. Instead, they want us to transfer some of our guild members to the Shattered Star Ring and try to open a branch there."

"Same for us. The club members feel that the opportunity to cross Star Fields is rare and cannot give it up. There might be additional benefits in the future."

Everyone replied. The president of the Power and Glory guild looked around and said, "It seems like the plans of all the large guilds are similar. We're going to let the vice president bring some people to cross Star Fields and explore the path for us."

Vodka walked out from the crowd and nodded at everyone. He was the candidate sent by the club to the Shattered Star Ring to manage the branch.

"I wonder what Australia will do. Probably the same as us."

"So, we still have to compete with them when we go to the Shattered Star Ring? Then we have to call some normal players over, or we'll be at a disadvantage. "

Because these six guilds were the authoritative representatives of the professional circle, they had a certain amount of appeal to the normal Russian players. If they raised their arms and set an example for the players, they would be able to attract a lot of people to follow them.

"Heh, it's not just the Australian guilds. That's the territory of China."

"Let's communicate with the Chinese clubs first. They've been operating there for three versions. After all, they're the owners. It's better to inform them before going over."

At the same time, the guilds in Australia also gathered together. The situation was similar to that in Russia, and they all came up with the same plan.

…

The Russian and Australian clubs quickly contacted the leading clubs in China. They were all in the same profession and had each other's contact information.

The various large guilds in China held a meeting.

Jade Green Sky has entered the chat room.

Morning Snow Twilight Frost has entered the chat room.

[Jupiter has entered the chat room.]

The presidents of Temple of God, Long Sky, Dynasty, and Fried Eggplants with Fish, as well as Thunder Storm, Fanatics, Rivervale, and some other famous official club guilds all entered the chat room.

Sky Territory's president, Jade Green Sky, said, "The Russians and the Australian club guilds want to come over? What are they doing? "

Drizzle River's president, Green Mountain Rain, said, "I can't help it. The Shattered Star Ring is our chosen home ground, and we've been operating there for three versions. I don't know what the club people are thinking, to actually agree to such a thing."

Nine Doors' president, Three Three Gets 9, said, "Take the stars, the club's Fruit Drop Suo Suo, as long as they agree."

Race of Gods' president, Jupiter, said, "… Type in Mandarin. I can't understand!"

Jade Green Sky said, "Eh? How old are you already, and you still call yourself a baby? Disgusting."

Ancient Dynasty's president, Morning Snow Twilight Frost, sent a funny smiley face.

They chatted for a while. Although they were the managers of the guilds under the club, they could not make the decision on this matter. They could only follow the wishes of the upper echelons of the club. The upper echelons told the guilds to prepare for the possible competition, and they could only follow.

They had no choice. The clubs did not want the competition to come and fight for resources. They wanted to monopolize the army's resources, but this was not their decision.

The Black Star Corps' actions were the result of the storyline. The army had decided to bring people back, and they could only accept the fact.

However, these guilds did not panic. The Shattered Star Ring was their base, and they had a huge advantage. The players from the Constellation Corridor would not be able to compete with them.

If these foreign club guilds did not cause any trouble, it would be fine. However, if they wanted to compete with the Chinese clubs for benefits … in order to ensure the resources of their own pro players, these famous clubs did not mind mobilizing their guild members to start a national war with the Chinese players and let these foreign guilds know who the real master of the Shattered Star Ring was.

Just as this topic was slowly fermenting, causing the players of the Constellation Corridor and the Shattered Star Ring to discuss it, Han Xiao and the others, who had been traveling slowly, finally arrived at Planet Gilman. For the first time, they had descended in front of the players of another Star Field.
